title: Setup page folder scan: follow-up of #2414

labels.name: effort:medium

body:
PR #2414 merged as ee49b0680 and closed #2380. The blocker of the first review is fixed. This issue tracks the non-blocking findings of the two reviews.

Sources: review comment 6975429429 (first review, head 0679b49f5) and review comment 6976557466 (re-review, head 6b9df50bb).

## Checklist

- [ ] Add an MCP tool for the folder rescan. Commands ship with an MCP tool. MCP has no call to `posting::rescan`, so an MCP session does not see a file added after the first scan.
- [ ] Show an unreadable folder to the user on every page that lists a folder. The read error is logged. The re-review says the post picker shows `FolderScan::problem`. Check the machine page too.
- [ ] Make the file name match in `crates/post/src/data_scan.rs` (line 41) exact, or match the table file name the same way on every OS. The scan matches case-insensitively. `builtin_post_text` and `builtin_machine_text` open the exact table name. On Linux, a file named `FANUC.CPS` is listed, and then the read is refused.
- [ ] Decide what a removed post does. A file read once and removed later still posts from the cached text until restart. The decision record names this. Either refresh the cache on a removal, or add a line to the decision record and to the page.
- [ ] Cache the names list in `post_pick::scan()`. It rebuilds `names` in each frame. The cost is small, but a cache keyed on a scan generation avoids the copy.
- [ ] Take a new "after" render of the machine page. `machine-page-after.png` in the PR body predates the merge of #2370.

## Done means

- Each box above is checked, or has a comment that gives the reason for leaving it open.
- Each behaviour change has a pinning test in `crates/ui/tests/` or `crates/app/tests/`.
